layer_change_gcode:
;------------------------------------
;layer No [layer_num] > Print Height[layer_z] mm
;LAYER:[layer_num]
;------------------------------------
;YUMI_PLR
LOG_Z
;@SNAPSHOT
;M118  A1 action:SNAPSHOT 
M117 Layer {layer_num + 1}/[total_layer_count]
machine_end_gcode:
M117 Finishing print (ORCA print end gcode)
; ORCA
M400 ; wait for buffer to clear
SET_SKEW CLEAR=1
; CURA 5.8.0
G91 ; Set Positioning to Relative
M83 ; Set Extruder to Relative
G92 E0 ; Reset Extruder
G1 E-1.5 F3000 ; Retract 4mm of filament
G1 Z0.2 ; Raise nozzle .2mm
G90 ; Set positioning to absolute
G1 X0 Y0 ; Park print head
G91 ; Set Positioning to Relative
G1 Z10 ; Raise nozzle 10mm
M106 S0 ; Turn off part fan
M104 S0 ; Set nozzle temp to zero
M140 S0 ; set bed temp to zero
M84 X Y Z E ; Disable X Y Z and E steppers
;YUMI_PLR
SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=was_interrupted VALUE=False
M117 execute clear last file
clear_last_file
G31
;BEEP
BEEP I=3 DUR=200 FREQ=800
M117 Printer has shut down
M300 S440 P200
M300 S660 P250
M300 S880 P300
; TIMELAPSE_RENDER only if auto render is off
; PRINT_END
M117 end or Orca print end gcode
END_PRINT
machine_start_gcode:
M117 Starting print (ORCA macro start)
M300 S440 P100
M117 Starting Preparations
M300 S440 P200
M300 S660 P250
M300 S880 P300
M117 execute CLEAR_PAUSE
CLEAR_PAUSE
RETRACTION=[filament_retraction_length] RETRACTIONSPEED=[filament_retraction_speed] 
M117 home all axis with G28
G28
M117 homing complete
; START_PRINT
;TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
; X5SA Start Code
G21 ; Set units to millimeters
G90 ; Set all axis to Absolute
M82 ; Set extrusion to Absolute
M107 ; Disable all fans
M117 start heating up
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; Set nozzle temp and wait
;TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
;G28 O L ; Home all "untrusted" axes
;G28 ; Home all axes
TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
;G28 X Y
; Uncomment the line below to enable ABL Mesh probing
M117 Auto Bed Level
BED_MESH_PROFILE LOAD=[filament_type]
@BEDLEVELVISUALIZER	
;G29 ; Probe bed mesh for ABL
; Klipper Bed Mesh
;TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE 
TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
; KAMP adaptive bed mesh
; For best results do not run nozzle heater while performing ABL
G1 Z5.0 F3000 ; Raise nozzle to prevent scratching of heat bed
G1 X0 Y0 F3000 ; Move nozzle to Home before heating
TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
M117 wiping nozzle
;M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; Set nozzle temp and wait
;TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
M117 start macro clean_nozzle
clean_nozzle  NOZZLE_TEMP=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] 
;TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
;SMART_PARK
M117 start macro G12 nozzle wipe
G12 NOZZLE_TEMP=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] WIPE_COUNT=15 
;TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
M117 Smart Park
SMART_PARK
M117 set nozzle temp
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; Set nozzle temp and wait
G92 E0 ; Set Extruder position to zero
; Uncomment the following lines to enable nozzle purge line along left edge of bed
M117 Draw Purge Lines
;TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
M300 S440 P200
;;G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; Raise Z axis
;;G1 X10.1 Y20 Z0.16 F3600.0 ; Move to purge line start position
;;G1 Y220 F1500.0 E10 ; Draw first purge line
;;G1 X10.4 F3600.0 ; Move to side
;;G1 Y20 F1500.0 E20 ; Draw second purge line
;;G92 E0 ; Reset Extruder
;;G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; Move Z Axis up little to prevent scratching of Heat Bed
;;G1 X5 Y20 Z0.2 F3600.0 ; Move over to finish nozzle wipe
G92 E0
SKEW_PROFILE LOAD=skew_profile_20250103
M117 Start KAMP
M300 S440 P150
SMART_PARK
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; Set nozzle temp and wait
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait
; KAMP purge
;TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
LINE_PURGE
TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME
;VORON_PURGE
; YUMI_PLR
G31 ; YUMI Clear PLR
M117 execute save last file
save_last_file
SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=was_interrupted VALUE=True
;beep
M300 S440 P200
M300 S660 P250
M300 S880 P300
M117 Starting up Slicer Start code complete
M117 Starting print in Slicer
BEEP I=3 DUR=200 FREQ=2000
;LAYER_COUNT:[total_layer_count]
;PRINT_START BED=[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] HOTEND=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] FILAMENT_PROFILE=[filament_type]
PRINT_START
